description: Linux 5.x / 6.x client SYN over Ethernet (MSS 1460), the kernel's own layout

provenance.notes: Measured on the Linux 6.18 kernel in the dev sandbox (TCP_MAXSEG=1460, TCP_WINDOW_CLAMP=4 MiB): no rewriting needed. Public data attests the option order MSTNW (98%), TTL 64 (96%) and no ECN (99%); its 'Linux' class is mostly Android (window 65535, scale 8 to 10), so it cannot confirm a desktop kernel's 64240 / 7. Kernel 6.1+ retransmits an unanswered SYN at 1, 2, 3, 4, 6, 10 s (tcp_syn_linear_timeouts), older kernels at 1, 3, 7, 15 s.
